static_review: Samples and archive members were analyzed without executing them or fetching their URLs. All 100 source bytes were SHA-256 verified.
changes: Require actual Base64 decoding and PowerShell evaluation before calling long Base64 data a hostile loader; rehome the data shape as neutral metadata.
Classify self-deletion plus download commands as suspicious; require concealed WSH execution, autorun, download and cleanup to identify the specific hostile staging chain.
Require a silent regsvr32 command for obfuscated DLL-registration staging.
Report clock sampling and file-attribute changes as neutral observations.
Recognize unconditional EXIT after IF as a syntax observation and clarify the Python launcher finding without claiming unreachable code executes.
Recognize Pythonw and quoted BIN/JSON file arguments.
Remove unsupported encryption/loader and EDR-unhooking claims inferred solely from section shapes, VirtualProtect, or library references; retain underlying observations.
Do not classify scanner, CLR library or packer identity by itself as hostile; override corresponding third-party findings.
Clarify descriptions of commands, evidence and reflected invocation.

validation.reason: Concurrent edits currently leave 54 parent-directory YAML files with rule-bearing children, plus unrelated registry security-hold, suppression, loop-budget and sibling-directory errors. No batch-improve rule was reported among these issues.

observations_reviewed.method: Enumerated all matched findings, reviewed the high-severity findings and selected descriptions and component claims; analyzed 100 samples including archive members.
